forensic_question: Where exactly can direct Realtime memory epistemic metadata be preserved, stripped or invented before cognition, and is the asynchronous claude_frage action carrier the same consumer path?

semantic_atoms.claim: After frank_erinnerung_lesen dispatch, the returned dict is JSON-serialized directly into a Realtime conversation.item.create function_call_output using the provider call_id, then response generation is requested. There is no intervening epistemic/provenance enrichment or validation wrapper at this serializer boundary.
semantic_atoms.implication: Any epistemic/provenance field absent from the reader result is still absent at model-context injection. Any future typed MemoryView must be constructed before this serializer or validated here without converting retrieval into truth authority.

semantic_atoms.claim: The Realtime function_call_output binds the tool response to the provider call_id. This is useful invocation correlation but does not identify the canonical memory source event, transformation lineage, verification state or state generation of each returned memory item.
semantic_atoms.implication: Keep provider call_id as invocation provenance, but do not substitute it for source_event_id/memory_admission_id/generation in the typed memory ABI.

semantic_atoms.claim: The asynchronous frank_auftrag_stellen carrier passes only the confirmed auftrag string into gespraechsmodus.claude_frage(). claude_frage constructs a claude -p command from that text, an end-intent system prompt, permission mode, disallowed Bash, and session resume/id. Its function body does not receive the direct frank_erinnerung_lesen result or call gespraech_zustandskontext as part of prompt construction.
semantic_atoms.boundary: A resumed Claude Code session may retain its own session context and hooks may observe system state, but this source does not prove typed direct-memory injection into that action carrier.
semantic_atoms.implication: Do not conflate Realtime memory-context epistemic repair with the action-carrier prompt path. Audit them as separate causal lanes.

semantic_atoms.claim: The existing lehre_unsicher uncertainty guard remains a separate state/GWT path and must not be lost when direct Realtime memory reads gain typed MemoryView metadata.

bounded_conclusion.non_goal: Do not make the model or serializer decide whether a remembered claim is fact.
